sentences.text: My name is Emily.
In this podcast, I speak slowly and clearly
to help you learn English.
This podcast is for beginners, so don't worry.
Just listen and enjoy.
Today, we are going to talk about Colombia.
Colombia is a very beautiful and interesting country.
It has amazing places, delicious food,
and friendly people.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
One, where is Colombia?
Colombia is in South America.
It is in the north of the continent.
Colombia has borders with Venezuela,
Brazil, Peru, Ecuador, and Panama.
Colombia is special because it has two coasts.
It touches the Caribbean Sea and the Pacific Ocean.
This means Colombia has many beautiful beaches.
The capital city of Colombia is Bogota.
Bogota is a big city in the mountains.
More than 7 million people live there.
Other big cities in Colombia are Medellin,
Colle, and Cartagena.
Nature in Colombia.
Colombia has amazing nature.
There are mountains, rainforests, rivers, and beaches.
The Andes Mountains go through Colombia.
Many people visit these mountains
to see the beautiful views.
Colombia also has part of the Amazon rainforest.
The Amazon is the biggest rainforest in the world.
It has many trees, plants, and animals.
A famous place in Colombia is Canyo Christalis.
It is called the River of Five Colors
because the water looks red, yellow, green, blue, and black.
Colombia also has beautiful beaches.
The Caribbean beaches have white sand and clear blue water.
People love to visit islands like San Andres
and Providencia.
Three, animals in Colombia.
Colombia has many animals.
It is one of the most biodiverse countries in the world.
One famous animal in Colombia is the Andean Condor.
It is a very big bird.
It is the national bird of Colombia.
Another special animal is the Pink River Dolphin.
This dolphin lives in the Amazon River.
It is not gray like other dolphins.
It is pink.
Colombia also has jaguars, monkeys, colorful frogs,
and many birds.
There are more than 1,900 types of birds in Colombia.
Four, food in Colombia.
Colombian food is delicious.
Here are some famous dishes.
Arepas. Arepas are round corn cakes.
People eat them with butter, cheese, or meat.
Bande hapisa.
This is a big meal with rice, beans, meat,
plantains, avocado, and an egg.
It is very popular in Medellin.
Ahiyako.
This is a special soup from Bogota.
It has chicken, potatoes, corn, and herbs.
Andpanadas.
These are small fried pastries
filled with meat, potatoes, or cheese.
Sancocho.
This is a soup with meat, yuca, plantains, and corn.
Columbians love to drink coffee.
Colombian coffee is famous around the world.
It is rich and smooth.
Many people visit Colombia
to see the coffee farms in the mountains.
People and language.
Colombia has a population of over 50 million people.
Most people in Colombia speak Spanish.
But Colombia also has over 60 indigenous languages.
Columbians are very friendly and welcoming.
They like to dance, celebrate, and enjoy life.
One popular dance in Colombia is kumbia.
Kumbia is a traditional dance with drums and flutes.
Another famous dance is salsa.
The city of Cali is called the capital of the world.
Festivals in Colombia?
Colombia has many festivals.
People love music, dancing, and celebrations.
One famous festival is carnival de Barranquilla.
It is the second biggest carnival in the world.
People wear colorful costumes and dance in the streets.
Another special festival is feria de las flores in Medellin.
This is the flower festival.
People make big flower displays and have a parade.
In Bogota, there is a big music festival called Rocal Parque.
It is one of the biggest free rock festivals in Latin America.
History and culture.
Columbia has a rich history.
A long time ago, indigenous people lived in Colombia.
One famous indigenous group was the Moiska.
They believed in a Golden King.
This is where the legend of El Dorado comes from.
Today, Colombia is a mix of indigenous, Spanish, and African cultures.
This mix makes Colombia unique and colorful.
Colombia is also famous for Gabriel Garcia Marquez.
He was a writer who won the Nobel Prize in literature.
His most famous book is 100 Years of Solitude.
That is all for today.
Now you know many things about Colombia.
It is a beautiful country with amazing people, food, and culture.
I hope you learned something new today.
If you liked this episode, please share it with your friends.
Bye-bye.
